RULE_4.title: Regulation of Packaging for Retail Sale
RULE_4.text: No person shall pre-pack or cause to be pre-packed any commodity for sale unless it bears mandatory declarations.

amendment_history.pdf_name: Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023 (18 of 2023)_1732708241.pdf

RULE_6_1_A.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Details
RULE_6_1_A.text: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly declared on package.

RULE_6_1_B.title: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
RULE_6_1_B.text: Common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package.

RULE_6_1_C.title: Net Quantity Declaration
RULE_6_1_C.text: Net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure or number.

RULE_6_1_D.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
RULE_6_1_D.text: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed.

RULE_6_1_E.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
RULE_6_1_E.text: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes in Indian Rupees (₹ or Rs.).

RULE_6_1_EA.title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
RULE_6_1_EA.text: Unit Sale Price declared as ₹ per g/kg/ml/l based on package net quantity size.

RULE_6_1_F.title: Consumer Care Contact Details
RULE_6_1_F.text: Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address for consumer complaints.

RULE_6_1_G.title: Country of Origin Declaration
RULE_6_1_G.text: Country of Origin of commodity explicitly declared for all imported packages.

RULE_7_FONT.title: Minimum Font Height Requirements
RULE_7_FONT.text: Minimum height of numerals and letters based on Principal Display Panel area.

RULE_11_UNITS.title: Standard Units & Prohibited Symbols
RULE_11_UNITS.text: Units of weight, measure or number shall be expressed in standard symbols: 'g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', 'm', 'N'. Non-standard symbols such as 'gms', 'gm', 'ML', 'KG.' are prohibited.
